items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Hotep Galeta, the pianist, the great South African pianist, he and I did a workshop for township students in Cape Town.

ctx.x: You know when I was in graduate school I thought about how do I find grants for different things. And — because there’s different kinds of programming I was thinking about wanting to do and then it came to a point I was invited to play at the North Sea Jazz

Festival in Cape Town. And being there, while there the organizers asked me to be one of the clinicians, a clinician to do a workshop. Hotep Galeta, the pianist, the great South African pianist, he and I did a workshop for township students in Cape Town. And from that point it was amazing, he was amazing, the feeling of the teaching and the response and the passion of the students for the music and how, what the music felt like for us, you know how we shared it. And from that point then I was asked to do a few…
We could use a good dose of that these days.
